gloss: nagging; fault-finding; forever telling people off

definitions.explanation: Describes a person who comments critically on every little thing, or an atmosphere full of such complaints. Almost always negative, suggesting the criticism is more frequent than the situation deserves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}やかましい。
{口|くち}やかましい⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I've grown tired of my fault-finding boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{口|くち}やかましくて、{夜遅|よるおそ}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The neighbors are so quick to complain that I can't even do laundry late at night.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth) + ⟦やかましい→やかましい：30268_yakamashii⟧ (noisy, fussy). The complaint is verbal, so it applies to people and to the social pressure they create, not to loud sounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口|くち}やかましい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a nagging person
- {口|くち}やかましく⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to go on and on about something
- {口|くち}やかましい⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧: a censorious public

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口|くち}うるさい→口うるさい：16036_kuchiurusai⟧: nagging — the more common everyday equivalent, essentially interchangeable
- ⟦やかましい→やかましい：30268_yakamashii⟧: noisy; fussy — covers actual noise as well as fussiness
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧: picky about details — can be neutral or even praise, unlike {口|くち}やかましい
